title: His soul traversed a period of desolation in which the sacraments themselves seemed to have turned into dried-up sources.
html_source: Religion is of decreasing importance to him.

anchor.text: His soul traversed a period of desolation in which the sacraments themselves seemed to have turned into dried-up sources.
anchor.prefix: and it was his constant failure to do this to his own satisfaction which caused in his soul at last a sensation of spiritual dryness together with a growth of doubts and scruples.
